refresh calls: of two concurrent calls with the same token, one succeeds and the other one

post.summary: Resolve a dispute (admin)
post.description:
Settles the dispute once. `release`: the pro is paid their payout in full; the job
moves to paid_out once the transfer is made. `refund`: the customer's total, tax included,
goes back to their payment method; the job moves to refunded; no transfer. `partial`: the
pro is paid `pro_release_cents` and the customer gets back the share of their total that
is not released (rounded half up to the cent); the platform keeps the rest. The amounts
come from the job's frozen payment, never from the client beyond `pro_release_cents`.
Sending the same decision again completes what is missing and changes nothing else; a
different one after the resolution is a 409. Both sides are notified, never with the
note, which is kept with the dispute and in the audit log.

unread_messages.description: The pro's chat messages the customer has not marked read (#71).

tip.description: The customer's tip for the pro (#273): set once the job was confirmed (by the customer or automatically), inside the tip window and after it; null for a job that takes no tip (not confirmed yet, disputed, refunded or cancelled). Always sent; optional in the schema so clients built before #273 keep compiling.

CustomerJob.title: CustomerJob
CustomerJob.description: The customer's job on their request, once paid.

customer_total_cents.title: Customer Total Cents
customer_total_cents.description: What the customer paid, tax included: the fee plus the refund, as the cancellation split it (frozen with it).

fee_cents.title: Fee Cents
fee_cents.description: Kept by the platform: 0 when cancelled before On my way.

refund_cents.title: Refund Cents
refund_cents.description: Given back to the original payment method.

refund_status.description: none, pending, succeeded or failed, as on the cancel's answer.

CustomerJobCancellation.title: CustomerJobCancellation
CustomerJobCancellation.description: The cancellation of the customer's job, as their job view shows it.

pending.title: Pending
pending.description: Photos not listed yet: their privacy-safe copy is still being made.

CustomerJobPhotos.title: CustomerJobPhotos
CustomerJobPhotos.description:
The pro's photos of the job, oldest first: only their privacy-safe copies (no location or
camera details).

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: How the pro will do the job, with contact details masked as in the scope; null when the pro wrote none.

CustomerQuote.title: CustomerQuote
CustomerQuote.description:
A quote on the customer's request (#188). `scope` and `approach` arrive with contact
details masked (app.redaction): the pro's own email and phone, then every contact pattern.
Never the pro's payout or the platform's fee.

items.title: Items
items.description: The accepted quote, if any, and the pending ones not yet expired: cheapest first, then oldest.

description.title: Description
description.description: What went wrong, as plain text. Contact details are masked before it is stored; only the masked text is kept.

photo_keys.title: Photo Keys
photo_keys.description: Keys of the caller's own dispute_photo uploads (POST /v1/uploads), in the order to show them. Optional; at most DISPUTE_PHOTO_MAX_COUNT.

url.title: Url
url.description: A signed GET URL, valid until expires_at.

DisputePhotoOut.title: DisputePhotoOut
DisputePhotoOut.description: One photo of the dispute, signed for a short while.

DisputeReason.title: DisputeReason
DisputeReason.description: What the customer says went wrong (#75).

message.title: Message
message.description: The pro's answer, as plain text, once. Contact details are masked before it is stored.

DisputeResolution.title: DisputeResolution
DisputeResolution.description: How an admin settles a dispute (#76).

pro_release_cents.title: Pro Release Cents
pro_release_cents.description: What the pro is paid; null while open.

customer_refund_cents.title: Customer Refund Cents
customer_refund_cents.description: What the customer gets back; null while open.

job_status.description: disputed until the money moved: paid_out once the transfer to the pro is made (a release, full or partial), refunded at once for a full refund.

refund.description: The refund, when the decision has one.

DisputeResolutionOut.title: DisputeResolutionOut
DisputeResolutionOut.description: Where the dispute stands after a resolve (#76).

pro_release_cents.title: Pro Release Cents
pro_release_cents.description: partial only (required there, refused otherwise): the part of the pro's payout to release, in integer cents, more than 0 and less than the payout. The customer's refund is computed from it on the server.

note.title: Note
note.description: Why, for the record (staff only: never shown to the customer or the pro, never logged). Kept with the dispute and in the audit log.

url.title: Url
url.description: Presigned GET URL of the file.

file_key.title: File Key
file_key.description: Key of the caller's own pro_document upload (POST /v1/uploads).

DocumentSubmission.title: DocumentSubmission
DocumentSubmission.description:
A pro submits a document; the review fields belong to the admin (#41): sending them is
a 422 (extra="forbid").

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The latest document of each type, superseded ones left out.

history.title: History
history.description: Older reviewed (approved or rejected) documents, newest first.

missing_types.title: Missing Types
missing_types.description: Required types with no pending or approved document.

names.title: Names
names.description: Display name per locale, e.g. en and es.

category.description: What the job was: the safe title.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: What the pro receives, in integer cents.

paid_at.title: Paid At
paid_at.description: When it was paid; null until then.

expected_by.title: Expected By
expected_by.description: awaiting_confirmation only: when the job confirms itself at the latest; null otherwise (the payout's own timing is Stripe's).

EarningStatus.title: EarningStatus
EarningStatus.description: Where a job's money stands, in the pro's words.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass it as `cursor` for the next page.

pending_cents.title: Pending Cents
pending_cents.description: Confirmed, the transfer still to be made.

EarningsSummary.title: EarningsSummary
EarningsSummary.description: All the pro's jobs, not just this page.

due_at.title: Due At
due_at.description: When it is due: in the future, at most OPS_FOLLOWUP_MAX_DAYS ahead.

note.title: Note
note.description: What to do, 1 to 500 characters (staff only).

assigned_to.title: Assigned To
assigned_to.description: An active agent or admin; the caller by default. Only an admin gives a follow-up to someone else.

FollowupItem.title: FollowupItem
FollowupItem.description: A follow-up in the list: its request's code and status, never a contact.

items.title: Items
items.description: By due time, the most overdue first.

due_today.title: Due Today
due_today.description: The caller's open follow-ups due by the end of today in the business time zone, overdue ones included: the length of GET /v1/admin/followups (due today).

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

JobAddress.title: JobAddress
JobAddress.description: Where the job is: the pro of a paid job sees the whole address, to get there.

names.title: Names
names.description: Display name per locale, e.g. en and es.

status.description: pending: the job is confirmed and the transfer to the pro's account is on its way to being made; created: the transfer was made.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: What the pro receives for the job (its pro_payout_cents), in integer cents.

JobPayout.title: JobPayout
JobPayout.description: The pro's payout for their job (#68), once the job is confirmed.

url.title: Url
url.description: A signed GET URL, valid until expires_at.

JobPhotoOut.title: JobPhotoOut
JobPhotoOut.description: One photo of the job, signed for a short while.

kind.description: before: while on the way or working; after: while working.

upload_keys.title: Upload Keys
upload_keys.description: Keys of the caller's own job_photo uploads (POST /v1/uploads), in the order to show them.

geometry.title: Geometry
geometry.description: The line to draw, from the pro to the address: `[lng, lat]` pairs in order (GeoJSON's order), thinned to a few hundred points at most.

duration_s.title: Duration S
duration_s.description: Seconds left, as estimated when computed.

steps.title: Steps
steps.description: The next streets of the route, in order: the first few dozen at most.

computed_at.title: Computed At
computed_at.description: When the route was computed. The same route is answered for a short while, until the pro has moved away from where it starts.

JobRoute.title: JobRoute
JobRoute.description: The pro's driving route to the job's address, as computed at `computed_at` (#351).

route.description: The pro's route to the job's address. null whenever there is none to show: the pro is not on the way (not yet, arrived, or the job moved on), has sent no position yet, the address cannot be placed on the map, no road leads there, or the route is being computed right now (ask again).

street_name.title: Street Name
street_name.description: The street's name; null on an unnamed road.

JobRouteStep.title: JobRouteStep
JobRouteStep.description: One stretch of the route on one street. No instruction text.

JobStatus.title: JobStatus
JobStatus.description:
Internal states (docs/glossary.md). Transitions belong to the state machine (#60).

A job is created when the payment succeeds, so there is no unpaid state.

type.title: Type
type.description: created, status_changed, eta_updated or checked_in; more come with later steps.

status.description: The status the job moved to, for created and status_changed; null otherwise.

JobTimelineEntry.title: JobTimelineEntry
JobTimelineEntry.description: One event of the job's history: what happened and when. No actor, no location.

transfer.description: The job's transfer; null before the first attempt to release it.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: 1 to 60 characters after trimming (inner spaces collapsed): letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and periods. No contact details (an email, phone number, website or handle, even spelled out). Both or neither.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: 1 to 60 characters after trimming (inner spaces collapsed): letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and periods. No contact details (an email, phone number, website or handle, even spelled out). Both or neither.

home_city.title: Home City
home_city.description: With home_state: both set, or both null to clear.

anyOf.description: A US state or DC code, upper case, e.g. FL.

home_state.title: Home State
home_state.description: A US state or DC code, upper case (FL); with home_city.

photo_key.title: Photo Key
photo_key.description: Key of the caller's own profile_photo upload (POST /v1/uploads); null clears.

locale.title: Locale
locale.description: The app language, as at sign-up: en or es. Never null.

MeUpdateRequest.title: MeUpdateRequest
MeUpdateRequest.description:
PATCH /v1/auth/me: the caller's own names (#165), ID card fields (#250) and app language
(#218). Omit a field to keep it. A name or the locale is never null. home_city and
home_state travel together: both set, or both null to clear them. photo_key null clears
the ID photo.

refunds_netted.title: Refunds Netted
refunds_netted.description: Whether revenue_cents is net of refunds: true (#76). Revenue is the fee the platform keeps: on the jobs confirmed in the range, and on the disputes resolved in the range (a release keeps the fee, a partial what its split left the platform, a full refund nothing). GMV covers the confirmed jobs only: the two cohorts differ on purpose.

series.title: Series
series.description: One point per day of the range, in order.

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

max_selected.title: Max Selected
max_selected.description: At most this many; all options when absent.

review.description: The caller's own review of this job; null when they wrote none. Never the other side's.

can_review.title: Can Review
can_review.description: True while the caller may still review this job: it was confirmed and they wrote no review yet.

closed_at.title: Closed At
closed_at.description: Set while the ticket is closed.

MySupportTicketOut.title: MySupportTicketOut
MySupportTicketOut.description: One of the caller's tickets in their list: no free text, so never the message.

body.title: Body
body.description: Plain text, 1 to 2000 characters, kept as written (staff only, never shown to the customer or the pro, never logged).

NotificationPreferences.title: NotificationPreferences
NotificationPreferences.description:
Every group, in a fixed order, with each of its channels: the user's choice, or the
default when they never changed it.

NotificationPreferencesPatch.title: NotificationPreferencesPatch
NotificationPreferencesPatch.description: 1 to MAX_CHANGES changes, each pair once and only a channel its group has.

eta_minutes.title: Eta Minutes
eta_minutes.description: Minutes until the pro expects to arrive.

url.title: Url
url.description: Single-use Stripe-hosted onboarding page; open it in a browser.

names.title: Names
names.description: Display name per locale, e.g. en and es.

OpportunityCategory.title: OpportunityCategory
OpportunityCategory.description:
The request's category, as this module shows it: its own strict model, not the shared
CategorySummary, whose extra fields would not be refused.

preferred_period.description: Set whenever preferred_date is; null without one.

viewed_at.title: Viewed At
viewed_at.description: When the pro first opened it.

text_redacted.title: Text Redacted
text_redacted.description: True when contact details were masked in the description or the answers (shown as •••): the customer is reached through the app.

media.title: Media
media.description: The photos and videos ready to show, oldest first.

media_pending.title: Media Pending
media_pending.description: How many more photos and videos are still being prepared.

take_rate_bps.title: Take Rate Bps
take_rate_bps.description: The platform's take rate in basis points (1500 = 15%), for the quote form's live 'you'll receive' preview only: the quote's response carries the amounts that count.

quote_max_amount_cents.title: Quote Max Amount Cents
quote_max_amount_cents.description: The highest price a quote may state, in cents, or null when the platform sets no cap: the quote form checks it before sending. Submitting enforces the same value.

quote_max_duration_minutes.title: Quote Max Duration Minutes
quote_max_duration_minutes.description: The longest estimated duration a quote may state, in minutes, or null when the platform sets no cap. Submitting enforces the same value.

city.title: City
city.description: The official city of the ZIP's service area; null when the area is no longer served. Never the text the customer typed.

OpportunityLocation.title: OpportunityLocation
OpportunityLocation.description:
Where the job is, as much as a pro may see before it is theirs: ZIP and city until the
job is paid (Cesar, 2026-10-22, #49). Any wider rule changes this schema only.

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: The copy's media type, e.g. image/jpeg.

OpportunityMedia.title: OpportunityMedia
OpportunityMedia.description:
A photo or video of the request: its privacy-safe copy (#173), without location or other
metadata, under a key that names no one.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

description_excerpt.title: Description Excerpt
description_excerpt.description: The start of the customer's description.

preferred_period.description: Set whenever preferred_date is; null without one.

viewed.title: Viewed
viewed.description: True once the pro has opened it.

text_redacted.title: Text Redacted
text_redacted.description: True when contact details were masked in the description (shown as •••).

new_password.title: New Password
new_password.description: Between the server's minimum (setting PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, 10 by default) and 128 characters, as at registration.

PaymentCreate.title: PaymentCreate

id.title: Id
id.description: The Stripe PaymentMethod id: the path id of the other routes.

brand.title: Brand
brand.description: Stripe's card brand: amex, diners, discover, eftpos_au, jcb, link, mastercard, unionpay, visa or unknown.

last4.title: Last4
last4.description: The card number's last four digits.

is_default.title: Is Default
is_default.description: Whether this is the customer's default payment method.

PaymentMethodOut.title: PaymentMethodOut
PaymentMethodOut.description:
A saved card as the wallet shows it: never the full number, the CVC, the fingerprint or
the billing details (the API never holds them).

payment_intent_client_secret.title: Payment Intent Client Secret
payment_intent_client_secret.description: The PaymentIntent's client secret: the sheet confirms the payment with it. Shown once per call, never logged; the same PaymentIntent on every call for the quote.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer's Stripe Customer id, for the sheet.

customer_session_client_secret.title: Customer Session Client Secret
customer_session_client_secret.description: A CustomerSession's client secret, new on each call: the sheet lists the customer's saved cards with it, and Stripe lets it neither remove one nor offer to save a new one (cards are added in the wallet). Shown once per call, never logged.

ephemeral_key_secret.title: Ephemeral Key Secret
ephemeral_key_secret.description: Deprecated (#253c): app builds before the CustomerSession pass it to the sheet, which then has full rights over the customer's cards. Use customer_session_client_secret; this field is removed in a later release.

publishable_key.title: Publishable Key
publishable_key.description: The Stripe publishable key the sheet initializes with (pk_test_ until launch).

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: The accepted quote's price, in integer cents.

tax_cents.title: Tax Cents
tax_cents.description: Tax on top of the price: 0, not charged in the MVP.

customer_total_cents.title: Customer Total Cents
customer_total_cents.description: What the sheet charges: the price plus the tax.

PaymentSheetOut.title: PaymentSheetOut
PaymentSheetOut.description:
What the app's Payment Sheet (#59) needs, plus what the customer sees before paying.
Never the pro's payout or the platform's fee.

PaymentStatus.title: PaymentStatus
PaymentStatus.description:
Where a payment stands (internal; the customer sees the request's status). Created
`requires_payment`; the payment webhooks (#61) move it on from the PaymentIntent's events.

PaymentSummaryOut.title: PaymentSummaryOut
PaymentSummaryOut.description: A job's payment as staff see it (#76): its amounts, frozen when it was made.

status.description: not_started: no payout account yet; incomplete: Stripe still needs information; in_review: everything is submitted and Stripe is checking it; enabled: payouts are on.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: One of the percents the job's tip options offer.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164, e.g. +14075550123, with an allowed country code.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: The number the code was sent to.

PhotoKindCounts.title: PhotoKindCounts
PhotoKindCounts.description: A count of the job's photos per kind.

PhotoOut.title: PhotoOut
PhotoOut.description: An image the caller may see: a pro's profile photo (#36), a user's ID photo (#250).

PreferredPeriod.title: PreferredPeriod
PreferredPeriod.description:
When in the preferred day the customer would like the visit (#237). Pros propose the
exact start in their quote; the period only refines a preferred date.

resolution.description: How an admin settled it; null while open.

photos_pending.title: Photos Pending
photos_pending.description: Photos whose copy is still being prepared.

reply.title: Reply
reply.description: The pro's own answer, once given.

ProDisputeOut.title: ProDisputeOut
ProDisputeOut.description: The report on the pro's job: the photos' safe copies only, once ready.

can_reply.title: Can Reply
can_reply.description: Whether the pro may still answer: open, no reply yet.

description.title: Description
description.description: The customer's description, contact details masked as in the opportunity.

address.description: The request's whole address; null once the job is cancelled or refunded.

customer_first_name.title: Customer First Name
customer_first_name.description: The customer's first name only; null when it is not set or shows a contact detail.

eta_at.title: Eta At
eta_at.description: The ETA the pro gave at On my way.

checked_in_at.title: Checked In At
checked_in_at.description: When the pro checked in with the customer's arrival code (Arrived).

arrival_code_locked.title: Arrival Code Locked
arrival_code_locked.description: True after too many wrong arrival codes: check-in is refused until support resolves it.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the pro marked the job done: the customer's confirmation window opens.

confirm_by.title: Confirm By
confirm_by.description: While the job is completed: when it is confirmed automatically if the customer neither confirms it nor reports a problem (the pro's Job's done plus JOB_AUTO_CONFIRM_AFTER_HOURS). Null in every other status.

pro_payout_cents.title: Pro Payout Cents
pro_payout_cents.description: What the pro receives for the job.

pro_receives_cents.title: Pro Receives Cents
pro_receives_cents.description: What the pro will actually receive for this job (#488): the full payout normally and while a reported problem is open (under review); once an admin resolved it, the full payout for a release, the released part for a partial, 0 for a refund; 0 for a cancelled or refunded job. pro_payout_cents stays the quote's frozen payout. Always sent; optional in the schema so older clients keep compiling.

cancellation.description: Set once the job was cancelled (#69): who, why and when. Always sent (null before a cancel); optional in the schema so clients built before #69 keep compiling.

payout.description: The transfer of that amount to the pro's account: null until the job is confirmed (and for a job that was never confirmed, or whose transfer was reversed).

unread_messages.title: Unread Messages
unread_messages.description: The customer's chat messages the pro has not marked read (#71).

ProJob.title: ProJob
ProJob.description: The pro's own job. Never the arrival code, the customer's last name or contacts.

ProJobCancellation.title: ProJobCancellation
ProJobCancellation.description:
The cancellation of the pro's job, as their job view shows it: who, why and when; never
the money or the note.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

pending.description: Listed photos whose privacy-safe copy is still being made: the customer does not see them yet.

failed.description: Listed photos whose privacy-safe copy could not be made: the customer never sees them.

ProJobPhotos.title: ProJobPhotos
ProJobPhotos.description:
The pro's own photos of the job, oldest first: each as its privacy-safe copy once it is
made, else the pro's original.

accuracy_m.title: Accuracy M
accuracy_m.description: The fix's accuracy radius in meters; null or left out when unknown.

heading_deg.title: Heading Deg
heading_deg.description: Direction of travel, in degrees clockwise from north; null or left out when unknown.

recorded_at.title: Recorded At
recorded_at.description: When the device took the fix, with its UTC offset. Refused when too far from the server's time (ahead or behind).

ProLocationIn.title: ProLocationIn
ProLocationIn.description:
One fix of the pro's device while on the way (#350). Numbers only: a string or a boolean
is refused, not converted.

position.description: The pro's latest position. null whenever there is none to show: the pro is not on the way (not yet, arrived, or the job moved on), has sent none yet, or the last one is too old.

accuracy_m.title: Accuracy M
accuracy_m.description: Accuracy radius in meters, when known.

heading_deg.title: Heading Deg
heading_deg.description: Direction of travel, in degrees clockwise from north, when known.

updated_at.title: Updated At
updated_at.description: When the server received this position.

rejection_reason.title: Rejection Reason
rejection_reason.description: Why the team rejected the profile, contact details masked; null unless rejected.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: An empty string or null clears it.

photo_key.title: Photo Key
photo_key.description: Key of the caller's own profile_photo upload (POST /v1/uploads); null clears.

category_ids.title: Category Ids
category_ids.description: Replaces the set: active categories, no duplicates, up to PRO_MAX_CATEGORIES.

service_area_ids.title: Service Area Ids
service_area_ids.description: Replaces the set: active service areas, no duplicates, up to PRO_MAX_SERVICE_AREAS.

ProProfileUpdate.title: ProProfileUpdate
ProProfileUpdate.description:
Only the fields sent change. Verification, payouts, rating and job count are set by the
platform: sending them is a 422 (extra="forbid").

name.title: Name
name.description: The first name and the last name's initial, e.g. "María P."; null when the pro has not set both names, or when the name shows a contact detail (an email, a phone, a domain...): withheld before payment, never partly masked.

rating_avg.title: Rating Avg
rating_avg.description: The average rating as a decimal string; null before the first review.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: The platform approved the pro's verification.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: What the pro wrote about their work, with contact details masked (app.redaction), as in a quote's scope: the pro's own email and phone, then every contact pattern; null when the pro wrote none.

categories.title: Categories
categories.description: The active categories the pro works in, by slug.

member_since.title: Member Since
member_since.description: The first day of the month the pro joined: month precision only.

ProPublicProfile.title: ProPublicProfile
ProPublicProfile.description:
The public profile of the pro behind a quote the customer can choose (#53), before
paying: the card's fields, the bio, the categories and the month the pro joined. Never a
contact, a document, the photo, the service areas, payouts or an internal id (the account,
Stripe).

reason.title: Reason
reason.description: Why, as plain text the pro reads (contact details are masked): required with rejected, refused with approved.

ProReviewIn.title: ProReviewIn
ProReviewIn.description: Staff's decision on a document or on a profile.

name.title: Name
name.description: The staff member's first name; null without one.

QueueBucket.title: QueueBucket
QueueBucket.description:
The one bucket a request is in, by this precedence (the first that matches). `other`:
none of them (accepted and unpaid, a job on another day, finished, cancelled, expired).

public_code.title: Public Code
public_code.description: The code the customer also sees, e.g. JF-000124.

customer_name.title: Customer Name
customer_name.description: First name and last initial ("Ana P."); null when a name is missing or shows a contact detail.

category.description: Null until the request is classified.

customer_status.title: Customer Status
customer_status.description: The glossary i18n key the customer sees.

bucket.description: The one bucket the request is in, by precedence: problems, urgent, new, waiting_customer, waiting_pro, quote_ready, scheduled_today; other when none applies.

first_contact_at.title: First Contact At
first_contact_at.description: Null until the BDC made contact.

assigned_agent.description: Who holds the request, if anyone.

QueueItem.title: QueueItem
QueueItem.description: A request in the queue: no phone, email, last name or street.

items.title: Items
items.description: Inside a bucket: the request waiting longest first. With bucket=all: the newest first.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

QueueSummary.title: QueueSummary
QueueSummary.description: How many requests each bucket holds now, and every request under `all`.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: The pro's price in integer cents (USD); the platform may set a lower cap.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: How I'll do the job: optional, apart from what the price includes. Trimmed; empty or blank is stored as no note (null).

proposed_start_at.title: Proposed Start At
proposed_start_at.description: When the pro proposes to start.

QuoteCreate.title: QuoteCreate
QuoteCreate.description:
A pro's fixed-price quote (#50). The server sets the status, the expiry, the pro and the
request; a client sending any of them gets a 422.

approach.title: Approach
approach.description: How I'll do the job, as the pro wrote it.

pro_payout_cents.title: Pro Payout Cents
pro_payout_cents.description: What the pro will receive: the amount minus the platform's fee. The customer pays the amount; the platform absorbs the card fee.

platform_fee_cents.title: Platform Fee Cents
platform_fee_cents.description: The platform's fee: the amount times the take rate, rounded half up to the cent.

QuoteOut.title: QuoteOut
QuoteOut.description:
The pro's own quote (#50), with what they will receive (#246). Never sent to the
customer: CustomerQuote does not extend it.

name.title: Name
name.description: The first name and the last name's initial, e.g. "María P."; null when the pro has not set both names, or when the name shows a contact detail (an email, a phone, a domain...): withheld before payment, never partly masked.

rating_avg.title: Rating Avg
rating_avg.description: The average rating as a decimal string; null before the first review.

verified.title: Verified
verified.description: The platform approved the pro's verification.

QuotePro.title: QuotePro
QuotePro.description:
The pro behind a quote, as the customer sees them before paying: never a contact, a
document, the photo or an internal id (the account, Stripe).

QuoteStatus.title: QuoteStatus
QuoteStatus.description: Internal states (docs/glossary.md). Transitions belong to the state machine (#60).

value.title: Value
value.description: The mean overall rating (1 to 5), to 2 decimals; null with no review.

average.title: Average
average.description: The average of the overall ratings of the caller's published reviews, to one decimal; null with none (No ratings yet).

count.title: Count
count.description: How many published reviews the caller received. A review the caller has not answered yet is not counted until it is published.

value.title: Value
value.description: numerator / denominator, to 4 decimals; null when the denominator is 0.

RatioMetric.title: RatioMetric
RatioMetric.description: `numerator` of `denominator`, so the panel can show "12 of 40".

Receipt.title: Receipt
Receipt.description:
How far a message got with its recipient, the participant who did not send it: sent,
delivered (their app fetched it) or seen (they marked it read). From the recipient's read
marker and deliveries (#331).

ReceiptAddress.title: ReceiptAddress
ReceiptAddress.description: The customer's own address, on the in-app receipt only: line 1, city and state.

ReceiptIssuer.title: ReceiptIssuer
ReceiptIssuer.description: Who issues the receipt (Q-R1): the API's settings, never the app's.

kind.description: The app names the line by its kind.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: Integer cents; negative for an amount returned.

at.title: At
at.description: When it went back, for a returned amount; else null.

receipt_number.title: Receipt Number
receipt_number.description: The request's public code: one receipt per job.

paid_at.title: Paid At
paid_at.description: When the job's payment went through.

pro_name.title: Pro Name
pro_name.description: The pro's public name; null when none can be shown.

completed_at.title: Completed At
completed_at.description: When the pro marked the job done.

total_paid_cents.title: Total Paid Cents
total_paid_cents.description: Service plus tax plus tip, minus what went back.

payment_method.description: null until Stripe's charge was read, and for a payment it gave no card for: the app then says Card.

tip.description: Whether a tip can still be added and until when; null for a job that takes no tip.

issuer.description: Who issues the receipt; null until both values are set on the server.

ReceiptOut.title: ReceiptOut
ReceiptOut.description:
A job's receipt, from the frozen amounts: the price and tax as charged, the tip once it
went through and each amount that went back. Never the platform's fee or the pro's payout,
and no Stripe id.

ReceiptPaymentMethod.title: ReceiptPaymentMethod
ReceiptPaymentMethod.description: The card that paid, as Stripe's charge describes it: never more than this.

can_tip.title: Can Tip
can_tip.description: Whether a tip can still be added (the job's tip window).

refresh_token.title: Refresh Token
refresh_token.description: The refresh token from the last AuthResponse.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: What is refunded, in integer cents.

status.description: pending: Stripe holds no refund of ours yet, an attempt may be under way. created: Stripe holds the refund; stripe_status says whether the money is back. failed: the last attempt's call failed. A retry sends the same idempotency key, and Stripe answers a refusal it already gave under that key (for 24 h) with the same refusal: a retry helps when the call never reached Stripe, or once the key expired.

stripe_refund_id.title: Stripe Refund Id
stripe_refund_id.description: Stripe's id of the refund, once made.

stripe_status.title: Stripe Status
stripe_status.description: Stripe's status of the refund as last read, as Stripe says it: succeeded (the money is back: only then is the dispute settled), pending or requires_action (not finished: the dispute stays open), failed or canceled (it never will be: staff repair it). Null until Stripe answered with the refund.

last_error_code.title: Last Error Code
last_error_code.description: Why the last attempt did not make the refund: a Stripe error code, an error class or `refund_needs_review`. Never a message.

RefundOut.title: RefundOut
RefundOut.description: A refund to the customer as staff see it (#76): the row, without the idempotency key.

password.title: Password
password.description: Between the server's minimum (setting PASSWORD_MIN_LENGTH, 10 by default) and 128 characters. No composition rules.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: 1 to 60 characters after trimming (inner spaces collapsed): letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and periods. No contact details (an email, phone number, website or handle, even spelled out). Both or neither.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: 1 to 60 characters after trimming (inner spaces collapsed): letters, spaces, hyphens, apostrophes and periods. No contact details (an email, phone number, website or handle, even spelled out). Both or neither.

public_code.title: Public Code
public_code.description: The code the customer also sees, e.g. JF-000124.

customer_name.title: Customer Name
customer_name.description: First name and last initial ("Ana P."); null when a name is missing or shows a contact detail.

category.description: Null until the request is classified.

customer_status.title: Customer Status
customer_status.description: The glossary i18n key the customer sees.

bucket.description: The one bucket the request is in, by precedence: problems, urgent, new, waiting_customer, waiting_pro, quote_ready, scheduled_today; other when none applies.

first_contact_at.title: First Contact At
first_contact_at.description: Null until the BDC made contact.

assigned_agent.description: Who holds the request, if anyone.

description.title: Description
description.description: As the customer typed it: it may hold contacts.

media_pending.title: Media Pending
media_pending.description: Copies still being made; not shown yet.

job.description: Null until the request is paid.

notes.title: Notes
notes.description: The staff's internal notes, oldest first (#82). Never shown to the customer or the pro.

actions_allowed.title: Actions Allowed
actions_allowed.description: Whether the caller may act on this request now (#82): it is unassigned, held by them, or they are an admin. The API stays the guard (409 request_held).

RequestCard.title: RequestCard
RequestCard.description:
One request for the BDC: everything in the list, plus who to call and where, what was
asked, the media, the quotes and the job. Reading it is recorded in the audit log.

preferred_date.title: Preferred Date
preferred_date.description: Today or later, as a UTC date.

preferred_period.description: When in the preferred date. Defaults to flexible with a date; without one, only flexible (or nothing) is accepted, and none is stored.

intake_answers.title: Intake Answers
intake_answers.description: Answers to the category's intake_questions (GET /v1/categories), by question key: an integer, an option value, a list of distinct option values, a boolean or a text, as each question's type says. Empty without a category. A size limit applies; NUL characters and non-finite numbers are refused. Text is stored trimmed.

media_keys.title: Media Keys
media_keys.description: Keys of the caller's own request_media uploads (POST /v1/uploads).

public_code.title: Public Code
public_code.description: The code shown to the customer, e.g. JF-000124.

customer_status.title: Customer Status
customer_status.description: The glossary i18n key the customer sees.

address_id.title: Address Id
address_id.description: The customer's own address the request uses (#69: Request again offers it when it is still in their address book). Always set; optional in the schema so clients built before #69 keep compiling.

preferred_period.description: Set whenever preferred_date is; null without one.

next_cursor.title: Next Cursor
next_cursor.description: Pass as `cursor` for the next page.

RequestStatus.title: RequestStatus
RequestStatus.description: Internal states (docs/glossary.md). Transitions belong to the state machine (#60).

ResolutionDecision.title: ResolutionDecision
ResolutionDecision.description:
What the admin decides (#76): the pro paid in full, the customer refunded in full, or a
split of the two.

value.title: Value
value.description: The mean, in minutes to 1 decimal; null when no request had a contact.

median.title: Median
median.description: The median, in minutes to 1 decimal.

denominator.title: Denominator
denominator.description: Requests of the range with a first contact.

line1.title: Line1
line1.description: "<number> <street>", or the street alone without a number.

served.title: Served
served.description: Whether an active service area covers the ZIP.

ReverseAddressOut.title: ReverseAddressOut
ReverseAddressOut.description: The US street address at the position, and whether its ZIP is a served area.

ReversePositionIn.title: ReversePositionIn
ReversePositionIn.description:
A device position. Strict: numbers only (no strings or booleans), finite, in range,
and nothing but the two coordinates.

comment_redacted.title: Comment Redacted
comment_redacted.description: True when something in the comment was masked: the app tells the author that contact details are not shared in reviews. False otherwise, and with no comment.

quality.title: Quality
quality.description: Optional, 1 to 5. From the job's customer only: refused (422) from the pro.

value.title: Value
value.description: Optional, 1 to 5. From the job's customer only: refused (422) from the pro.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: Optional text, trimmed. Contact details in it (phones, emails, links, handles, addresses) are replaced by ••• before it is stored; only the masked text is kept.

comment.title: Comment
comment.description: The text as stored: contact details were replaced by ••• when it was written.

ReviewOut.title: ReviewOut
ReviewOut.description: The caller's own review, as stored.

label.title: Label
label.description: The customer's own name for it, e.g. "Home" or "Casa 2".

anyOf.description: Decimal degrees, kept to six decimals.
Decimal degrees, kept to six decimals.

SavedAddressIn.title: SavedAddressIn
SavedAddressIn.description:
A saved address: the address fields, its label, optional coordinates (both or neither)
and whether it becomes the default. The customer's first address is the default anyway.

SavedAddressList.title: SavedAddressList
SavedAddressList.description: The caller's saved addresses: the default first, then the oldest first.

served.title: Served
served.description: True when the ZIP has an active service area; otherwise the app offers the waitlist.

anyOf.description: The customer's own name for it, e.g. "Home" or "Casa 2".
Decimal degrees, kept to six decimals.
Decimal degrees, kept to six decimals.

SavedAddressPatch.title: SavedAddressPatch
SavedAddressPatch.description:
Any subset of the fields. A field left out stays as it is. `line2` sent as null is
cleared; so are `lat` and `lng`, sent as null together. `is_default` can only be true here:
the default moves by making another address the default, never by unsetting one.

sender.description: me for the caller's own messages, else the other side: customer or pro.

body.title: Body
body.description: The text as stored: contact details (phones, emails, links, addresses) were replaced by ••• when it was sent.

redacted.title: Redacted
redacted.description: True when something in the text was masked.

receipt.description: On the caller's own messages (sender me): seen once the other side marked it read, delivered once their app fetched it (a page of the chat returned it), sent before that. Null on the other side's messages. A push notification does not count as delivered.

warning.description: contact_details_hidden when something in the text was masked (redacted is true): the app tells the sender that contact details are not shared in the chat. Null otherwise.

client_secret.title: Client Secret
client_secret.description: The SetupIntent's client secret: the sheet confirms the card with it. Shown once per call, never logged; a new SetupIntent on every call.

ephemeral_key_secret.title: Ephemeral Key Secret
ephemeral_key_secret.description: Deprecated (#253c): always null. The setup sheet opens without the customer (with a key, Stripe would let it list, remove and reuse saved cards behind the API), so no key is minted; the field stays for one release and is then removed.

customer_id.title: Customer Id
customer_id.description: The customer's Stripe Customer id, for the sheet.

publishable_key.title: Publishable Key
publishable_key.description: The Stripe publishable key the sheet initializes with (pk_test_ until launch).

SetupIntentOut.title: SetupIntentOut
SetupIntentOut.description: What the app's Payment Sheet needs, in setup mode, to save a card on the customer.

ShownRefundStatus.title: ShownRefundStatus
ShownRefundStatus.description:
A dispute's refund as staff see it: the one that is not abandoned (#434), so never
`abandoned`. The same values as RefundStatus otherwise.

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

original.title: Original
original.description: What the sender typed, for a redacted message whose original is still kept (encrypted, for CHAT_ORIGINAL_RETENTION_DAYS); null otherwise, or when it cannot be read. Every response that carries one is audited.

receipt.description: How far the message got with the other side (the one who did not send it): seen, delivered or sent, as its sender sees it.

customer_total_cents.title: Customer Total Cents
customer_total_cents.description: What the customer paid, tax included; null when the job's payment is missing (a dispute that needs review).

pro_payout_cents.title: Pro Payout Cents
pro_payout_cents.description: The pro's payout frozen at payment.

opened_at.title: Opened At
opened_at.description: When the customer reported it: its age.

refund_failed.title: Refund Failed
refund_failed.description: Stripe failed or canceled the decision's refund: the money did not go back, the dispute stays open (or, resolved, needs a look) and any payout it decided stays held. Staff repair it.

refund_needs_reconciliation.title: Refund Needs Reconciliation
refund_needs_reconciliation.description: Stripe shows a refund made (or still under way) for this dispute that its abandoned or failed refund records do not hold (#450 round 2): money may have gone back outside the records, so any payout of the job stays held until staff reconcile it in Stripe and clear the hold (docs/stripe-money.md). Never cleared on its own.

pro_reply.title: Pro Reply
pro_reply.description: The pro's one answer, as stored (masked).

StaffDisputeOut.title: StaffDisputeOut
StaffDisputeOut.description: A dispute in full for staff (#76). Reading it is recorded in the audit log.

customer_total_cents.description: What the customer paid, tax included; null when the job's payment is missing (a dispute that needs review).

pro_payout_cents.title: Pro Payout Cents
pro_payout_cents.description: The pro's payout frozen at payment.

refund_failed.title: Refund Failed
refund_failed.description: Stripe failed or canceled the decision's refund: the money did not go back, the dispute stays open (or, resolved, needs a look) and any payout it decided stays held. Staff repair it.

refund_needs_reconciliation.title: Refund Needs Reconciliation
refund_needs_reconciliation.description: Stripe shows a refund made (or still under way) for this dispute that its abandoned or failed refund records do not hold (#450 round 2): money may have gone back outside the records, so any payout of the job stays held until staff reconcile it in Stripe and clear the hold (docs/stripe-money.md). Never cleared on its own.

StaffDisputeSummary.title: StaffDisputeSummary
StaffDisputeSummary.description: One line of the staff list.

StaffDocumentCounts.title: StaffDocumentCounts
StaffDocumentCounts.description: A pro's documents by status, superseded ones left out.

url.title: Url

StaffDocumentReviewOut.title: StaffDocumentReviewOut
StaffDocumentReviewOut.description: A document as a review answers it: never its file.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Null when missing or showing a contact.

StaffMemberOut.title: StaffMemberOut
StaffMemberOut.description: An active agent or admin, as the panel's assignee pickers list them (#82): no contact.

StaffProDecisionOut.title: StaffProDecisionOut
StaffProDecisionOut.description: A profile as a decision answers it.

name.title: Name
name.description: First name and last initial ("María P."); null when a name is missing or shows a contact detail.

zip_count.title: Zip Count
zip_count.description: How many ZIPs the pro serves.

submitted_at.title: Submitted At
submitted_at.description: When the oldest document still pending was submitted; null with none.

StaffProItem.title: StaffProItem
StaffProItem.description: A pro in the staff list: no email, phone, last name or address.

name.title: Name
name.description: First name and last initial ("María P.").

legal_name.title: Legal Name
legal_name.description: First and last name as on the account, to match the ID document; null when the account has neither. Only this detail carries it, never the list.

bio.title: Bio
bio.description: As the pro wrote it: it may hold contact details.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The latest document of each type, superseded ones left out.

history.title: History
history.description: Older reviewed (approved or rejected) documents, newest first.

missing_types.title: Missing Types
missing_types.description: Required types with no pending or approved document.

approval_blockers.title: Approval Blockers
approval_blockers.description: What an approval still needs; empty when the pro can be approved.

StaffProStatusCounts.title: StaffProStatusCounts
StaffProStatusCounts.description: Every pro profile by verification status.

user_first_name.title: User First Name
user_first_name.description: The writer's first name alone; null when they have none or it shows a contact detail.

role.description: The writer's role when they wrote the ticket.

job_id.description: The job the ticket is about, if any.

user_first_name.description: The writer's first name alone; null when they have none or it shows a contact detail.

role.description: The writer's role when they wrote the ticket.

job_id.description: The job the ticket is about, if any.

message.title: Message
message.description: The writer's text, as typed: it may hold contact details.

closed_at.title: Closed At
closed_at.description: Set while the ticket is closed.

status.description: open: a new ticket waits for the team.

message.title: Message
message.description: The text, trimmed. Stored as typed and read by the team only: a phone or an email written here is kept, so the team can reach the writer.

job_id.title: Job Id
job_id.description: The job the ticket is about: one of which the caller is the customer or the pro. Leave out when the ticket is about no job.

platform.description: The device the ticket was written on.

status.description: The ticket's new status. Any status may follow any other (a closed ticket can be reopened); the same status again changes nothing.

key.title: Key
key.description: The answer's key in intake_answers; unique in the category.

labels.title: Labels
labels.description: The question per locale; en and es required.

TicketPlatform.title: TicketPlatform
TicketPlatform.description: The device the ticket was written on, as the app reports it.

TicketRole.title: TicketRole
TicketRole.description:
Who wrote the ticket, as they were when they wrote it: the app's users only (agents and
admins use the panel and write no tickets).

TicketTopic.title: TicketTopic
TicketTopic.description: What the ticket is about, as the user picked it in the app.

TipChoice.title: TipChoice
TipChoice.description: What the customer chose (#273): no tip, one of the offered percents, or an amount.

sheet.description: What the Payment Sheet needs to pay the tip (its amount, no tax); null for No tip.

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: The percents offered for this job, ascending; a percent whose amount falls outside the bounds below is left out.

max_cents.title: Max Cents
max_cents.description: The largest tip, inclusive: a share of the job's price, capped.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: The offered percent chosen; null otherwise.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: The tip, in integer cents; 0 until chosen and for No tip.

can_tip.title: Can Tip
can_tip.description: Whether a tip may be chosen or paid now: inside the window, nothing paid or being paid yet.

closes_at.title: Closes At
closes_at.description: When the window closes: the job's confirmation plus TIP_WINDOW_HOURS.

TipOut.title: TipOut
TipOut.description: The job's tip: what the customer chose, where its payment stands and what they may do.

percent.title: Percent
percent.description: A whole percent of the job's price.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: What that percent comes to, computed by the server (rounded half up): the app shows it as is.

TipStatus.title: TipStatus
TipStatus.description:
Where a tip stands. `declined` is the choice "No tip" (no PaymentIntent); the others
follow the current attempt's PaymentIntent, moved by its payment_intent.* events.

amount_cents.title: Amount Cents
amount_cents.description: The job's pro payout as frozen at payment (or the part of it an admin released on a dispute, #76), in integer cents.

status.description: pending: not made yet (last_error_code `payouts_not_enabled` when the pro cannot be paid out yet). created: Stripe made the transfer. failed: the last attempt failed and is tried again. reversed: Stripe reversed the transfer.

stripe_transfer_id.title: Stripe Transfer Id
stripe_transfer_id.description: Stripe's id of the transfer, once it is made.

attempts.title: Attempts
attempts.description: Attempts made with Stripe so far.

last_error_code.title: Last Error Code
last_error_code.description: Why the last attempt did not make the transfer: a Stripe error code, an error class, `payouts_not_enabled`, `pro_not_approved`, `held_before_create` (a hold seen at the last check before the create) or `transfer_needs_review`. Never a message.

create_may_have_been_issued_at.title: Create May Have Been Issued At
create_may_have_been_issued_at.description: When an attempt first went past the last check before the create (#450 round 5): from then on Stripe may hold a transfer of the job, even while a later attempt retries. Kept for good; null when no attempt ever got that far.

needs_reversal_at.title: Needs Reversal At
needs_reversal_at.description: When a refund made late for the job's dispute found this transfer made, or possibly made (#450 round 4): the hold came too late to stop it. TransferOut.title: TransferOut
TransferOut.description:
A job's transfer to its pro as staff see it (#68): the row, without the idempotency
key.

TransferStatus.title: TransferStatus
TransferStatus.description:
Where the pro's transfer for a job stands (D13.3, #68; internal: the pro sees `pending`
or `created`, staff see the row).

content_type.title: Content Type
content_type.description: An allowed MIME type, e.g. image/jpeg.

size_bytes.title: Size Bytes
size_bytes.description: Exact size of the file; it is signed into the URL.

key.title: Key
key.description: Where the file will live; features store it.

headers.title: Headers
headers.description: Send exactly these headers with the PUT, or the storage rejects it.

phone.title: Phone
phone.description: E.164, set once verified by SMS code.

first_name.title: First Name
first_name.description: Null for accounts created before names.

last_name.title: Last Name
last_name.description: Null for accounts created before names.

public_code.title: Public Code
public_code.description: The ID card's code: 8 Crockford base32 characters (0-9, A-Z without I, L, O, U), fixed at sign-up. Shown grouped as XXXX-XXXX.

home_state.title: Home State
home_state.description: A US state or DC code, e.g. FL; null until set.

photo.description: The ID photo, a presigned GET; null until set.

member_since.title: Member Since
member_since.description: The day (UTC) the account was created.

UserOut.title: UserOut
UserOut.description:
